thematic_title: Map It, Move It — Grade 3 Geometry
descriptive_title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Geometry in 2D and 3D (E1.1-E1.4)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 3 unit on geometry framed around Trekker Tig and Compass Coco. Children sort 5 named 3D solids, compose-decompose structures, identify congruent parts, and follow multistep maps with quarter and half turns.
long_description: Trekker Tig the Tiger Cub and Compass Coco the Cat are the geometers of Grade 3! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 3 unit covers all 4 E1 expectations (E1.1-E1.4). Day 1 sorts 5 named solids by faces, edges, vertices. Day 2 composes and decomposes structures. Day 3 introduces CONGRUENT (same size + same shape). Day 4 introduces multistep movement with QUARTER (90°) and HALF (180°) turns. Day 5 closes with a Big Map Capstone integrating all 4 expectations. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a Grade-3 trap: cylinder/cone mix, partial-decompose, size-blind, turn-size, no-check), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives, formative + reflection sheets, full assessment suite with 4-row summative rubric, and Junior Geometer G3 certificates.
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 3 teachers looking for a fully scaffolded 5-day geometry unit (E1.1-E1.4).
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Hands-on geometry investigation with character-driven exploration frame, structured pair work, and progressive complexity from G2 spatial unit.
